column1: # REGISTER 4 — mutation-proofs.tsv   STUBS ONLY, FROZEN at HEAD 0cdd5b1
# One row per guard file in reference-impl/tests/. mutation, decoy and observed are DELIBERATELY
# EMPTY: wave 2 fills them BY EXECUTION. date is filled when the proof is run.
#   rows with mutation/decoy/observed filled  0  (by design — wave 2's job)
#   Excluded from the population, counted: tests/asserts.py and tests/inputs.py (shared helpers in
#   the tests directory), plus reference-impl/conftest.py (one level up). 3 files, none of which
#   contains a test_* function, so none is a guard.
# HOW target_defect_class WAS WRITTEN, and the trap it avoids
#   It states what the guard EXISTS FOR — taken from the guard's own module docstring where it
#   has one (50 of 61), and from its test-function names where the docstring is empty (11 of 61).
#   It is NOT 'any defect this guard happens to catch'. A mutation chosen from the second list
#   proves only that the guard is not vacuous; a mutation chosen from the first proves the guard
#   does the job it was written to do. Wave 2 must mutate against THIS column, not against
#   whatever the guard turns out to be sensitive to.
#   mutation  the exact edit that introduces the target defect class (file, line, before -> after).
#   decoy     an edit in the same neighbourhood that does NOT introduce the defect and MUST NOT
#             be flagged. Without a decoy a red result proves only that the guard is noisy.
#   observed  what actually happened when both were run: which tests failed on the mutation and
#             that none failed on the decoy. Recorded from execution, never predicted.
# FREEZE RULE: the row list is final — 61 rows, one per guard. Wave 2 fills cells; it does not
# add rows. A guard added after this HEAD goes to OPEN-ITEMS.md.

column2: target_defect_class
A wind-transport law that is stated as arithmetic (Bagnold threshold, cubic flux) silently stops being that arithmetic — exactness lost to a refactor.
The fan generator removes material or stamps outside the debouch, i.e. a depositional landform behaving erosively.
An analysis operator (slope/curvature/aspect/Laplacian) stops matching its closed-form answer on a terrain whose analytic value is known.
An analytic closed-form law (tephra log-linear thinning, sqrt-age depth, GDH1, energy-cone runout, PDC inundation, superelevation) drifts off its own formula.
A labelled anatomy diagram stops building, or its printed labels stop matching what the code computes.
LATTICE anisotropy and FIELD anisotropy get conflated, so a lattice artefact is read as physical directionality (or vice versa).
An archetype composition stops satisfying the `09` verification signature its blueprint in 20-archetypes.md advertises.
Chapter pseudocode, the executable reference impl, and ATOM-COVERAGE.md's scope statement drift apart — an atom documented but not shipped, or shipped but out of scope.
An audit document (NODE-PARITY-AUDIT, VALIDATION, SIMULATION-AUDIT) claims a gap that is already built, or quotes a test count / scorecard cell that no longer matches the tree.
An emergent result agrees only with an oracle re-derived from our own code, not with an independent analytic continuum solution.
The domain edge silently changes behaviour — an open perimeter printing an edge-pit fringe into a simulation.
The braided-river cellular model stops reproducing the STATISTICS of braiding (it is pinned on statistics, not on a photoreal image).
A number a chapter quotes stops matching what the module actually computes — the chapter-prose-versus-code numeric drift class.
A path-shaped citation in prose names a file that does not exist (or a symbol/line that does not exist inside it).
SatMap/CLUT compositing or a 2-D biome LUT stops behaving as a channel-driven lookup that combines rather than replaces.
Impact SIZE physics drifts off the Collins/Melosh/Marcus pi-scaling exponents and the 1/g transition; obliquity SHAPE stops being morphologically right.
Our result is self-consistent with 09's oracles but disagrees with a mature independent library (RichDEM / pysheds).
Three further node families agree with our oracles but disagree with Landlab.
The diffusion solver stops decaying a single Fourier mode at the exact analytic rate, stops conserving mass, or blows up on a spike.
A load-bearing equation becomes dimensionally inconsistent — machine-checked with pint.
The droplet eroder stops being deterministic, stops conserving mass, or acquires a SYSTEMATIC (not random) grid bias.
The Werner slab model stops conserving slabs exactly, stops requiring p_sand > p_bare for the deposition instability, or stops organising transverse dunes from shadow+avalanche.
Generated terrain's emergent statistics (Hack's exponent, Horton ratios) fall outside the range measured on real landscapes.
empirical_dem.py — the ENTIRE evidence for VALIDATION.md's top rung — ships untested and its real-DEM comparison silently rots.
Depression filling leaves interior pits, spill levels are wrong, or flow accumulation stops conserving contributing area / stops being less grid-biased under MFD than D8.
The 03 D8-versus-MFD figure stops building, or the CLAIMS it prints stop holding.
A gallery panel looks fine but holds numerically insane relief — the stream-power-at-the-wrong-scale explosion class.
GALLERY.md's undrawn-modules table names modules or functions that no longer exist or no longer have that signature.
Glacial erosion stops matching the Halfar-validated SIA transport, or bed erosion stops being a monotone function of ice flux.
The demo harness stops obeying the same invariants the algorithms obey — legal wiring order and a valid rendered output.
The SIA figure's analytic exponents get hard-coded into the solver (a LEAK of the answer into the thing being tested) rather than emerging.
A heightfield save/load round-trip stops returning what was written, to the format's quantisation, for some interchange format.
The 3D hero renderer stops producing a finite camera solve and a valid non-blank RGB image.
Chapter 26's measured hex numbers (16.8% wrong-cell rounding rate, 30.5-degree naive-normal error, sqrt(3) two-axis anisotropy) stop being reproduced by hex_grid.py.
The water surface sits below the bed, lakes stop filling enclosed depressions, or rivers carry depth where there is no channel.
Airy root, erosional rebound ratio, or flexure stops matching its exact single-mode / line-load analytic solution.
A geological landform stops hitting its published numbers (Pike/Melosh depth/D, rim, r^-3 ejecta, central-peak onset, gravity pi-scaling) or strata stops being a periodic material coordinate.
The lithology -> spatial-K stream-power coupling stops producing differential erosion at steady state when K is a field or callable.
The 'Sum <= 1' and 'Sum = 1' mask rules get applied to the wrong object, so a reader implementing the assertion writes the wrong one.
Lateral migration loses the Ikeda-Parker-Sawai UPSTREAM LAG — near-bank velocity computed local instead of exponentially lagged.
Gradient noise stops being 0 on the lattice, one-octave fBm stops equalling the base noise, curl noise stops being divergence-free, or a fractal sum stops being bounded.
The lattice pinch-point artefact at lacunarity exactly 2 reappears, or 01's lacunarity claim stops matching the generator.
Individually-correct nodes combine into garbage — isolated spikes or a field that has lost its numerical contract.
A papers-free toolbox node loses the single property that makes it correct (SDF exactness, smin below the hard min, edge preservation).
Virtual-pipe water goes negative or non-finite on steep terrain, stops conserving water in a closed basin, or pipe_erode stops conserving bed mass.
A placement authored in METRES lands in a different world position at a different resolution, or a mask leaves [0,1].
A NUMBER inside a chapter's pseudocode block stops matching the shipped module's default or constant.
render.material_rgb lies about itself — the documented default pairing not being the actual default, and a positional parameter that should be keyword-only.
Runout stops matching the angle of reach, stops shortening under higher friction, or fails to stop on a flat from an initial velocity.
An atom parameter is silently in CELL units, so the atom changes meaning when resolution changes.
Bridson's minimum-distance guarantee is violated, density-following is lost, jitter stops being deterministic/tileable, or rule gates stop rejecting.
A screen-world composition blows up or loses the couple of invariants that make it a re-dressed Earth archetype.
The virtual-pipe shallow-water solver stops conserving mass or lets depth go negative.
An illustrative sim becomes grossly broken — these have no decisive oracle, so only gross-breakage invariants are asserted.
SKILL.md's frontmatter contract breaks, an eval loses integrity, a reference chapter stops being routed from SKILL.md, or a cross-validation/clean-room claim stops matching its dependencies.
A trig function is applied to `slope`, which is already a TANGENT — tan(tan theta), sin of a tangent: a units error that is not any physical quantity.
The snowpack stops accumulating where cold / melting where warm, stops stripping steep ground, or the avalanche stops relaxing to repose.
Steady-state slope-area scaling breaks, the channel network stops being concave, or the diffusion default stops being bit-for-bit the pure fluvial solver.
fault_scarp stops being the displacement fractal, or fault_weakness stops coupling an erodibility contrast to the fault.
Thermal erosion stops converging below repose, stops conserving mass, stops being resolution-independent in its repose angle, or loses the distance correction that removes grid bias.
The terrain-adjusted wind field loses Jackson-Hunt crest speed-up or lee separation — speed and direction stop responding to terrain.
